'''Ranneth''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]], Ranneth led a patrol unit on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] until they were ambushed by Imperial forces in the [[Advanced Product Research Sector]] of the [[Labor Valley]]. Ranneth was wounded and was the only one to escape, while the rest of his men were captured. However, a Republic hero was able to liberate the injured soldiers and deliver much-needed medical assistance before extracting them to the nearest Republic's tram station.
